description: This file defines a React component for a customizable menu item, including styling, event handling, and accessibility features, used within a menu system in a Mattermost web application.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining properties for the MenuItem component, including labels, icons, event handlers, and accessibility roles.

classes.name: FirstMenuItemProps
classes.description: TypeScript type for the props of the first menu item in a menu container, omitting certain properties.

classes.name: MenuItemStyled
classes.description: Styled component based on Material-UI's MenuItem, with custom styles for destructive actions, labels, and layout.

methods.name: MenuItem
methods.description: React functional component rendering a menu item with customizable labels, icons, event handling, and styling.

methods.name: isCorrectKeyPressedOnMenuItem
methods.description: Utility function to determine if a menu item was activated via keyboard or mouse according to WAI-ARIA guidelines.

methods.name: isRoleCheckboxOrRadio
methods.description: Helper function to check if a role is 'menuitemcheckbox' or 'menuitemradio'.
